linkRewriting.rule1: A relative link to a markdown file that IS in this manifest becomes /work/pcgo/docs/<slug>, keeping any #anchor.
linkRewriting.rule2: A relative link to any other file under docs/ becomes the GitHub blob URL (githubBlobBase + normalised path), opens in a new tab, and gets a small external-arrow marker.
linkRewriting.rule3: A relative link to a file outside docs/ (for example ../../README.md or source code) becomes the GitHub blob URL at the repo root, same treatment.
linkRewriting.rule4: Absolute http(s) links are left alone, open in a new tab, rel='noopener noreferrer'.
linkRewriting.rule5: The build prints a table of every rewritten link and FAILS if a link to a manifest doc points at a heading anchor that does not exist.
